title: Soul Healing
intro: I am currently undergoing an intensive training in Esoteric Soul Healing. As part of this training, I am **offering free sessions** (which also allow me to practice).
I can welcome four new people approximately every six weeks. If you are interested in participating, or have any questions, you are invited to [contact me](contact).
body: Esoteric Soul Healing is a form of energy healing that works with the energies of the whole person—the physical and energetic bodies, emotions, thoughts, personality and Soul. The Soul is the part of us that is eternal, connects us to each other, the divine and all life, and is filled with universal love. Healing is a process of returning to “wholeness” within yourself by redressing imbalances that have built up in the emotions, mind and body. Soul Healers recognise the presence of the Soul in all people and work with these powerfully transformative energies to facilitate people in their healing. With gratitude for the teachers of this path: Karin Persons, Kathy Jones and Alice Bailey.
